name: Balatonmagyaród (Hungary)
description: A vertical light grey banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Balatonmagyaród (a green and blue shield with a bridge and a bird) above the name BALATONMAGYARÓD in green.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
